title: Quantum Variance Conjectures for Matrix Elements
exact_target: Prove the predicted averaged off-diagonal variance and the Gaussian diagonal fluctuations, including the time-reversal factor.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001925 (OWR-11447-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: The catalogue formula suppresses the averaging bar and can be misread as exact equality for each matrix entry. The primary source calls this a distributional variance conjecture in the semiclassical near-diagonal regime, with j distinct from k and frequency (E_j-E_k)/hbar tending to zero. The Gaussian assertion is an asymptotic distribution claim under the source's chaotic-dynamics setting, not an identity for every observable and Hamiltonian.
